newsitem.title: UGANDA: SOCCER-SECURITY PROBLEMS FORCE ZAIRE CANCELLATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SECURITY PROBLEMS FORCE ZAIRE CANCELLATION.

text.p: Security fears in Zaire's capital Kinshasha have prompted the cancellation of a Confederation of African Football (CAF) cup match scheduled for next month.

Ugandan soccer officials said CAF general secretary Mustaphy Fahmy had written to them to cancel the first leg of the second round tie between Uganda's Kampala City Council and Zaire's AS Bantous, set for the first weekend of May.
Fahmy said the match would now be decided by one game only, to be played in Kampala on either May 16, 17 or 18.
Security in Kinshasha has deteriorated recently as Zairean rebels have captured a vast swathe of the country from the east in their advance on the capital.
